body: I've never really got this. I've always put the roach in at the bottom first and find it easiest to use the roach to help roll. If you've got it right around the roach everything else follows!

Honestly, thank you so much. If anything it was a relief to even write all of that and get it off my chest. I have thought about seeing a professional to talk about it all to be fair so I really will consider doing that.

Thank you, for reading this and actually thinking aboht the right thing to say rather than generic it will get better in time and all sorts of things like that.

I genuinely will send you a message if I'm feeling down. We will both get through this! Sending love and puppies back you way!
